title: Updated Measurements of [O III] 88 μm, [C II] 158 μm, and Dust Continuum Emission from a z = 7.2 Galaxy
question: What are the updated measurements and spatial structures of [O III] 88 μm, [C II] 158 μm, and dust continuum emission in the z = 7.212 galaxy SXDF-NB1006-2, and how do they affect its [O III]/[C II] luminosity ratio and L_[C II]-SFR relation?

recipe.goal: Split target fields, standardize visibility weights, and combine multi-cycle MSs
recipe.method: Extract target galaxy fields with split, adjust visibility weights of Cycle 1 [C II] data using statwt (excluding serendipitous CO(5-4) channels), and combine MSs across cycles using concat.
key_parameters: fitspw = all spws excluding serendipitous CO (J=5-4) channels from SSTSL2 J021856.14-051951.4

recipe.goal: Create spectral line cubes and dust continuum images
recipe.method: Image line cubes and continuum with tclean using natural weighting. Apply uv-tapering from 0.1" to 0.5" (step 0.1") on combined Cycles 2+3 [O III] data to maximize S/N. Exclude line frequency ranges when imaging Band 8 and Band 6 continuum.
key_parameters: [O III] bin width = 20 km s^-1; [C II] bin width = 25 km s^-1
weighting = natural, outframe = BARY, veltype = optical
assumptions: z = 7.212; rest-frame frequencies 3393.006 GHz ([O III] 88 μm) and 1900.54 GHz ([C II] 158 μm)

recipe.goal: Generate integrated intensity (moment-0) maps for emission lines and sub-clumps
recipe.method: Integrate data cubes over velocity using immoments for full lines and individual velocity-optimized clumps, masking atmospheric ozone channels at ~231.28 GHz and testing removal of a suspicious edge velocity bin in [C II].
key_parameters: [O III] velocity integration ranges: -310 to +250 km s^-1 (Cycle 3), -280 to +260 km s^-1 (Cycles 2+3); detailed clump ranges in Table 4

[C II] velocity integration ranges: -80 to +145 km s^-1 (Cycle 1, Cycles 1+3, Cycle 7, Cycles 1+3+7), -70 to +155 km s^-1 (Cycle 3), -80 to +120 km s^-1 (Cycles 1+3+7 without edge bin), +70 to +170 km s^-1 (SE), -80 to +170 km s^-1 (NW)

recipe.goal: Measure integrated fluxes, deconvolved source sizes, line profiles, and background rms
recipe.method: Fit 2D Gaussians to sources in moment-0 maps using imfit (or manual FWHM contour deconvolution for 3.6σ [C II]), fit 1D Gaussians to peak-pixel spectra using specfit, and calculate background rms via 10 iterations of 3σ clipping around the median.
key_parameters: specfit ngauss = 2 (clump A), ngauss = 3 (clumps C' and C'')
3σ clipping iterated 10 times for background rms

recipe.goal: Derive upper limits on total IR luminosity and dust mass
recipe.method: Integrate a modified blackbody function over 8-1000 μm for L_TIR and apply Equation (22) of Inoue et al. (2020) to the Band 6 3σ flux density upper limit for dust mass.
assumptions: T_dust = 40 K, β = 1.5, κ_ν = 30 cm^2 g^-1 x (100 μm / λ)^β, omitting CMB temperature effect

recipe.goal: Calculate [O III]/[C II] luminosity ratios, apply SBD corrections, and evaluate L_[C II]-SFR deficit
recipe.method: Compute line luminosities and L_[O III]/L_[C II] ratios for both 4.5σ and 3.6σ [C II] detections, apply surface brightness dimming (SBD) correction factors based on θ_beam / D_source from Carniani et al. (2020), and compare against L_[C II]-SFR relations and Lyα-derived SFRs.
